label: Some n is an actual concretum at w, has no ACTUAL_CONCRETE_GROUND_1 under the selected relation…
paraphrase: Some n is an actual concretum at w, has no actual concrete ground under the selected relation there, exists at each world accessible from w, and has no distinct simply-prior predecessor. This same n is in potency in no supplied respect (the existing PureAct predicate), without asserting any positive InAct perfection or completeness of the respect domain. No uniqueness, maximum, God identification, universal causality or other-world rootness is asserted.
